correctness.rationale: The sufficient-subdivision theorem identifies the natural two-edge-arm Abrams cubical complex equivariantly with the original unordered three-point space. The one-essential-vertex radial-tree theorem guarantees H0=Q and H_k=0 for k>1. Every fixed cubical cell has an orientation sign accounted for by permuting its edge axes, giving a complete two-case signed generating function whose coefficient z^3 is c1-C(c1,2)-2C(c1,3)+c2+c3. Subtraction from H0 yields the exact character for every m≥3 and every arm permutation. Factorial moments of permutation cycles prove the invariant subspace has dimension zero. Fresh finite verifier directly enumerates cells and signs for 41 conjugacy classes (all group elements for m≤5), verifying but not replacing the symbolic proof.

originality.rationale: The precise claim is the complete natural rational arm-permutation representation character on unordered collision-free three-point star configurations, not the known radial-tree free-group rank. Primary inspections cover the most plausible star-group presentation and ordered-configuration stability theorems; these give ranks/generators or ordered stability, not the explicit natural action. published-finding corpus and historical-claim comparisons did not find a covering formula. Possible derived or unindexed equivalent results remain material residual risks.
residual_risks: An unindexed paper might have an equivalent automorphism action or character computation.
The known star-braid-group presentations may allow an indirect derivation of the same character without stating it.
Available literature and database search are not exhaustive, and similarity retrieval does not establish mathematical uniqueness.

value.rationale: Full symmetry characters are natural invariants of graph braid spaces that distinguish actions invisible to a wedge-of-circles classification. The exact infinite-family formula determines every rational S_m representation up to isomorphism and proves vanishing of the full arm-symmetry-invariant subspace. These are motivated structural statements about particle exchanges under physical graph automorphisms, not a finite arbitrary parameter slice or a cosmetic rewriting of the already known Betti rank.
